new_entities.name: Separate technical unit (luggage rack, ski rack, radio aerial)

obligations.subject: e10
obligations.response: approval of that vehicle type shall be granted
obligations.ears: When the vehicle type submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 5. and 6. below, approval of that vehicle type shall be granted.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle type approved
obligations.ears: An approval number shall be assigned to each vehicle type approved.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval
obligations.ears: The first two digits of the approval number (at present 03, corresponding to the 03 series of amendments) shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: may not assign the same number to another vehicle type
obligations.ears: The same Contracting Party may not assign the same number to another vehicle type.

obligations.subject: e2
obligations.response: shall be communicated to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this Regulation
obligations.ears: Notice of approval or of extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval or production definitively discontinued of a vehicle type pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 1 to this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation an international approval mark
obligations.ears: An international approval mark shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every vehicle conforming to a vehicle type approved under this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: the additional numbers and symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.1.4.l.
obligations.ears: When the vehicle conforms to a vehicle type approved, under one or more other Regulations annexed to the Agreement, in the country which has granted approval under this Regulation, the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.1.4.1. need not be repeated and the additional numbers and symbols of all the Regulations under which approval has been granted shall be placed in vertical columns to the right of the symbol prescribed in paragraph 4.1.4.l.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be clearly legible and be indelible
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

derived.text: The approval mark shall be clearly legible.
The approval mark shall be indelible.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the vehicle data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of the conformity of production before type approval is granted
obligations.ears: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of the conformity of production before type approval is granted.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: approval of that type of separate technical unit shall be granted
obligations.ears: When the type of separate technical unit submitted for approval pursuant to this Regulation meets the requirements of paragraphs 6.16., 6.17. and 6.18. below, approval of that type of separate technical unit shall be granted.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: An approval number shall be assigned to each type of separate technical unit approved
obligations.ears: An approval number shall be assigned to each type of separate technical unit approved.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval
obligations.ears: The first two digits of the approval number (at present 03 corresponding to the 03 series of amendments which entered into force on 23 June 2005) shall indicate the series of amendments incorporating the most recent major technical amendments made to the Regulation at the time of issue of the approval.

obligations.subject: n4
obligations.response: may not assign the same number to another type of separate technical unit
obligations.ears: The same Contracting Party may not assign the same number to another type of separate technical unit.

obligations.subject: n2
obligations.response: shall be communicated to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 4 to this Regulation
obligations.ears: Notice of approval, or of extension or refusal or withdrawal of approval or production definitively discontinued, of a type of separate technical unit pursuant to this Regulation shall be communicated to the Parties to the 1958 Agreement applying this Regulation by means of a communication form conforming to the model in Annex 4 to this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: There shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every separate technical unit conforming to a type approved under this Regulation, an international approval mark
obligations.ears: An international approval mark shall be affixed, conspicuously and in a readily accessible place specified on the approval form, to every separate technical unit conforming to a type approved under this Regulation.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be clearly legible and be indelible
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be clearly legible and be indelible.

The approval mark shall be indelible.

obligations.subject: n1
obligations.response: shall be placed close to or on the separate technical unit data plate affixed by the manufacturer
obligations.ears: The approval mark shall be placed close to or on the separate technical unit data plate affixed by the manufacturer.

obligations.subject: n3
obligations.response: shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of conformity of production before type approval is granted
obligations.ears: The Type Approval Authority shall verify the existence of satisfactory arrangements for ensuring effective control of conformity of production before type approval is granted.
